title: Item:Concentrated Elixir of Mnemonic Enhancement
wikitext:
__NOTOC__ {{Top}} {{See also|Mnemonic Enhancer}} Consuming a mnemonic elixir restores consumed [[spell point]]s to your character. Additionally, it cures [[Feeblemind]].
